facts.fact: On 22 September 2026 the health ministry opened validation of the 2025 health statistics yearbook, built on the national DHIS2 base; it is not yet published.

TCD.note: Names DHIS2 but states no tiers, digitisation level or clinic coverage.

facts.fact: The health ministry's 2025 health statistics yearbook, in validation on 22 September 2026, rests on the national DHIS2 platform base.
